newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS MONDAY EASIER ON UNITS.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS MONDAY EASIER ON UNITS.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar closed on Monday easier on the U.S. unit, sterling and the rand compared to Friday's levels but was quoted a toucn firmer on the mark after a rather lacklustre interbank trading session, dealers said.
"It was a very quiet trading day. There were not too many inflows or outflows today," one dealer commented.
The local unit ended the day at 11.3080/3180 from Friday's 11.3050/3150 against the U.S. dollar and was at 18.4925/5225 from 18.4800/5000 against sterling.
It was also a touch softer on the rand at 2.5140/5145 compared to 2.5100/5300 but was quoted firmer on the mark at 6.5340/5380 from 6.5400/5600.
